entity.title: SteerSpec Platform
entity.description: The SteerSpec platform: the rule format (strspc-rules), the enforcement engine (strspc-manager), the CLI, the configuration sync tool and the planned cloud service. Rules here are cross-cutting; each component owns its own realm.

rules.body: Dependencies MUST point downward only: strspc-rules is consumed by strspc-manager, which is imported by strspc-CLI and strspc-cloud, and a lower tier MUST NOT import a higher one.
Releases MUST land upstream first (strspc-rules, then strspc-manager, then strspc-CLI and strspc-cloud), each consumer pinning a released version of the tier it depends on.

Every SteerSpec repository that ships platform code or rules MUST own its rules as a SteerSpec realm in that repository, and every realm other than dev.steerspec.core MUST depend on dev.steerspec.core at a released version.
Every realm-owning repository's CI MUST validate its realm and the lifecycle of its rules on each pull request.
A Published or Implemented rule MUST NOT be edited; a change MUST be expressed as a new rule that supersedes it.
Rule validation, diffing, evaluation and resolution logic MUST live in strspc-manager, and the CLI and cloud tiers MUST only present its results.
